name: jira-review
description: Rigorous, technology-independent code review of the pull request attached to a Jira ticket: 28-point checklist over the diff, PASS/FAIL report with severities, findings posted to the PR (Bitbucket or GitHub) and to Jira, QA handoff on PASS and rework handback on FAIL, every run recorded on a shared ledger. All workflow names, hosts and people come from each repository's .claude/jira-project.json.
